label: Standardised version of parental care variable - average across both parents (CLS Harmonisation)
meta_rows: Standardised version of parental care variable - average across both parents (CLS Harmonisation)

CLOSER work package 9: Harmonised childhood environment and adult wellbeing measures. Standardised variables were derived using z-score transformations.  Unstandardised: 0 (not caring) to 33 (very caring). Standardised: -3.73 to 1.501
cat_rows: This category contains information on the parental bonding instrument. The Parental Bonding Instrument was included on the 1989 self completion questionnaire. Of the 25 items in the scale one was omitted (item 4: Seemed emotionally cold to me), and 5 items were reworded from a negative direction to a positive direction (items 2, 8, 14, 18 and 24). The scale using NSHD was originally created by Bryan Rodgers and used in Reported parental behaviour and adult affective symptoms.
freq_note: Missing values and distribution outside 5th and 95th percentiles removed from both the plot and the statistics above.
